title: Successive Palindrome Agreement Conditions
statement: Let $x$ be a binary word and let $i<|x|$. Suppose the bits at position $i$ in $x$ and its reversal agree. Then all opposing pairs at or after position $i$ agree if and only if all opposing pairs at or after position $i+1$ agree.
hypotheses_covered: The bits at position $i$ in $x$ and its reversal agree
replaced:
Let $x$ be a binary word and $i < |x|$ an index at which the $i$-th bit of the
reversal $x^{R}$ equals the $i$-th bit of $x$. Then all opposing pairs of $x$ at
or after position $i$ agree if and only if all opposing pairs at or after
position $i+1$ agree.
